name: Startup Visibility OS
headline: Built something great?
subheadline_top: Learn how to get discovered without relying entirely on paid ads.
subheadline: Startup Visibility OS helps founders build discoverability, authority, and distribution systems using modern SEO, AI search optimization, Reddit, and founder-led content.

painPoints.title: Does this sound familiar?
items: You built the product... but nobody discovered it.
You launched quietly, waiting for users who never arrived.
You don't have an existing audience to share it with.
You can't spend thousands of dollars on paid ads.
Your Product Hunt launch came and went, but didn't change everything.
painPoints.outcome: If you answered yes, Startup Visibility OS was built specifically for you.

daysPlan.title: First 7 Days Implementation Plan
daysPlan.description: This is a structured, action-oriented, day-by-day roadmap. Execute these tasks consecutively to build momentum.

days.title: Positioning
tasks: Define your target customer's acute pain points.
Isolate your product's 'One True Hook' that promises the quickest resolution.
Compare your headline against the Founder Positioning Framework.
Identify 3 competing solutions and list their positioning gaps.

days.title: Homepage Optimization
tasks: Format your landing page sections to follow the High-Converting Formula.
Refine copy to focus on outcomes over list of features.
Inject structured FAQ JSON-LD schema into your page head.
Verify page loads in under 2 seconds to optimize for search indexers.

days.title: Reddit Authority Setup
tasks: Identify and join the top 10 subreddits relevant to your SaaS category.
Set up automated keyword alerts for conversations mentioning problems you solve.
Draft 3 value-first comments that help users without mentioning your product.
Optimize your Reddit bio with a link to your landing page.

days.title: SEO Cluster
tasks: Locate 3 low-difficulty informational search queries in your niche.
Outline a 3-article topic cluster that answers these queries fully.
Write and publish your first search-intent piece.
Ensure internal links point directly to your homepage conversion points.

days.title: Founder Content
tasks: Draft your authentic Founder Story explaining why you built this SaaS.
Write 3 LinkedIn or X status updates focusing on technical lessons learned.
Identify 5 ideal early buyers and send them personalized, non-spammy direct messages.
Schedule your content to maintain consistent distribution activity.

days.title: Launch Preparation
tasks: Submit your SaaS details to 10 high-domain-authority directories.
Prepare your launch day media (screenshots, demo video, logos).
Write your launch announcement using the Launch Thread Formula.
Queue up support from peers and early waitlist members.

days.title: Review and Iterate
tasks: Audit your site analytics to check search, Reddit, and direct traffic.
Examine search index status using Google Search Console.
Collate feedback from early visitors and identify primary points of confusion.
Tweak headlines and SEO keywords based on search and user data.

founderStory.quote: I built LaunchXact believing great products naturally got discovered. They don't. I realized discoverability itself is a system. Startup Visibility OS is the framework I wish I had when nobody knew my startup existed.
founderStory.title: Founder, LaunchXact

faq.question: Who is this for?
faq.answer: This is built specifically for solo developers, indie hackers, and early-stage SaaS founders who have a working product but need traffic, authority, and early users without spending money on paid advertising.

faq.question: Is this beginner friendly?
faq.answer: Absolutely. You do not need any marketing degree. We supply copy-paste formulas, step-by-step checklists, and structured prompts to write and launch your visibility system.

faq.question: Will this create overnight virality?
faq.answer: No. Overnight virality is rare and mostly a vanity metric. We teach you a repeatable, compounding distribution system that drives sustainable organic traffic day after day.

faq.question: Do I need paid ads?
faq.answer: No. The entire system is built around free, high-intent traffic sources like Reddit community support, organic SEO, AI search index listings, and founder-led content.

faq.question: How do I access it?
faq.answer: As soon as you complete the checkout on our platform, you will be redirected to a secure purchase page containing direct downloads for the PDFs and access links to the Notion templates and Google Docs.

faq.question: Are updates included?
faq.answer: Yes. You purchase it once and get lifetime access to all databases and prompts, including free access to all future updates and additions we make.
